text: After this you can read a control trend to determine whether commanded operation occurred.

A building automation system can command devices, maintain setpoints, and record measurements. Each point should have a clear meaning: command, feedback, status, or sensor value. Review time histories to determine whether systems followed their intended operating schedules. A wrong sensor or unclear sequence may explain an apparent inefficiency. Any control change must preserve equipment limits and required building service.
